broader_roadmap.feature: Customizable info bar/data broker plugins, placement and per-stat display, zero clutter by default
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: 15 data fields, per-character export, 1-second refresh cost measured

broader_roadmap.feature: Prat features: advanced chat search, user-defined channels, class/level coloring, abbreviations, edit-box behavior and copied history
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Search returns exact lines after /reload; modules independently toggle

broader_roadmap.feature: Theme consistency: consistent page navigation, scrollable responsive tables, standardized status chips, gamepad-friendly focus
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Small/large resolution screenshot set, no text clipping

broader_roadmap.feature: Minimap scale/shape and map UI customization without competing owner of protected frames
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Settings tested in combat and with Leatrix/ElvUI on

broader_roadmap.feature: More robust cross-addon detection and user-facing conflict screen: who owns bag/map/quest/raid frames
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: One owner per frame, modules independently yield; explicit diagnostics

broader_roadmap.feature: Account character roster: skills, rested cap, money, inventory, mail, lockouts, exact freshness and actionable tasks
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Show 10 characters, 'last updated' per category and no stale total disguised as current

broader_roadmap.feature: Account-wide progression/checklist dashboard: keys, rare collection, recipe completion, exploration, attunement
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Character-level and account-level progress independently tracked

broader_roadmap.feature: Optional party/guild attunement and quest readiness checks, sharing only explicitly approved metadata
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Consent per channel/category, deny unknown add-on payloads

broader_roadmap.feature: Guild utility directory: recipes/crafters and verified instance readiness, opt-in and no server-wide census broadcasts
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Permissioned sharing and opt-out support

broader_roadmap.feature: Cross-character errands orchestration: optimal character to log into, mail or craft next
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Actionable steps with no automation

broader_roadmap.feature: Every module publishes an explicit capabilities/coverage contract, data freshness and known limitations to advisor

broader_roadmap.feature: Module interoperability test matrix (Questie, Auctionator, Baganator, HealBot, ElvUI)
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: No double overlays, no frame ownership conflicts, one on/off switch per integration

broader_roadmap.feature: User-visible source provenance & accuracy ratings for every recommendation, including Forever map coordinate changes
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Trace source and timestamp in every actionable card

broader_roadmap.feature: Low-resource certification with peak RAM, idle/active CPU, frame/timer caps and load-on-demand packs
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Measured before/after in 30-minute gameplay; hard caps, pooled frame tests

broader_roadmap.feature: Automatic addon feature coverage report and release notes generated from manifests and tests
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: No claims of parity until in-game verified

broader_roadmap.feature: Data pack updater/verification workflow on desktop, explicit consent, versioned snapshots, no in-game network calls
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: Works offline when not updating; no surprise traffic or unlicensed data imports

broader_roadmap.feature: Accessible onboarding: presets for solo/leveling, hunter, dungeon, raid healer, trader, gatherer
broader_roadmap.minimum_acceptance: 10-minute first-use test per persona, opt-in settings and rollback
